sources.title: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model

Trained from scratch on 45 trillion tokens: text, image, audio, video
Apache 2.0 license
1M token context window via open weights (256K on hosted API)
Tinker fine-tuning platform launched same day (July 15, 2026)
First model built entirely from scratch by Thinking Machines Lab

sources.title: Open-Source AI Compliance: EU AI Act Exemptions Explained
claims: EU AI Act entered into force August 1, 2024; GPAI obligations began August 2, 2025
European Commission enforcement powers apply from August 2, 2026
Open-source exemption (Article 53(2)): partial exemption for GPAI models under open licenses
Exemption disappears entirely for models with systemic risk (≥10²⁵ FLOPs)
Copyright policy and training data summary obligations remain regardless of open-source status
April 2026 EC guidance: exemption interpreted narrowly; documentation and provenance still required

European data governance and GDPR-compliant positioning
